svg.title: Payroll
svg.desc: BPMN process with Employee and Supervisor, Payroll Accounting, and Treasury lanes, plus external tax and benefit recipients. Approved time leads to a payroll register, then parallel employee-payment and liability-remittance streams with an eventual synchronization.
